name: John J. Keeshan
summary: Corporal John J. Keeshan is a weary human veteran of the Great Wars, having served in the Alliance military through decades of brutal conflict. After being captured by Blackrock orcs during the fighting around Stonewatch, he was dragged deep into Render's Rock as a prisoner of war.

sections.title: A Lifetime of Warfare
sections.body: Few living soldiers have seen as much combat as John J. Keeshan. A veteran of the First, Second, and Third Wars, Keeshan served across an astounding 248 consecutive tours of duty under Colonel Troteman in Bravo Company. The decades of ceaseless violence took a devastating personal toll; his wife, Jade, was slain by Blackrock orcs during the fighting, leaving him with little beyond her pendant and the hard-bitten instincts of a battlefield survivor. By the time fighting flared up in the Redridge Mountains, Keeshan was still in the thick of it, carrying the scars and memories of a lifetime spent under arms.

sections.title: Captivity at Render's Rock
sections.body: When the Blackrock clan pushed north out of the Burning Steppes into the Redridge Mountains, Keeshan stood among the defenders battling for Stonewatch Keep. Overwhelmed by the orcish assault, he was captured alive rather than slain on the field. The Blackrock invaders hauled him captive into the depths of Render's Rock, leaving the veteran imprisoned behind enemy lines until Alliance rescue parties could fight their way in to break him out.

faq.answer: John J. Keeshan is a veteran soldier of the Alliance military who fought through the First, Second, and Third Wars as part of Bravo Company. Known as Johnny to old comrades, he is an exceptionally hardened combatant who survived hundreds of tours of duty.

faq.q: Why is Keeshan imprisoned in Render's Rock?
faq.answer: During the battle against the Blackrock clan around Stonewatch Keep, Keeshan was overwhelmed, captured alive by the orcs, and hauled back to their encampment inside the caves of Render's Rock.
Keeshan's wife, Jade, was murdered by Blackrock orcs during the wars. Following her death, Keeshan wore her pendant as a keepsake of her memory.

faq.q: What unit did Keeshan serve with?
faq.answer: Keeshan served in Bravo Company under the command of Colonel Troteman, fighting alongside comrades such as Messner, Jorgensen, Krakauer, and Danforth across the Great Wars.

angles.text: Keeshan represents the steep human cost of the Alliance's unending war against the Blackrock orcs, having sacrificed his youth, family, and peace of mind in service to Stormwind.
For warriors, Keeshan is a grim testament to sheer martial endurance, having survived hundreds of frontline engagements across three world-altering wars.
